scores.evidence: Both mermaid flowcharts (s1-diagram, s3-diagram) use flowchart TD and are readable at 390 px with Japanese labels and captions (pages/mobile-jp-04.png, pages/mobile-jp-12.png, pages/mobile-jp-13.png). The code blocks s2-skill, s3-file and pr-model fit with their highlights visible (pages/mobile-jp-06.png, pages/mobile-jp-14.png, pages/mobile-jp-23.png). metrics.json shows no overflow, broken images, mermaid errors or unknown blocks.

textOnlyScreens is empty on both desktop-jp and mobile-jp. Text alternates with definitions, diagrams, code, steps and quizzes, with no walls of text (pages/mobile-jp-03.png to pages/mobile-jp-21.png). Desktop JP charsPerLine median is 39, inside the 30–40 target.

The lesson is Japanese-only and every screen shows consistent Japanese text. Diagram labels are in Japanese and large enough to read, contrast is good on code and callouts (pages/mobile-jp-17.png), and the bottom bar hides no control: each Answer button is reachable on the next screen. No personal data appears on any screen: the desktop sidebar shows only the EN/JP switch and icons (pages/desktop-jp-01.png).

niceToHave: check-quiz (e1): at 390 px the path chips `~/.claude/skills/api-guide/SKILL.md` and `.claude/skills/api-guide/SKILL.md` wrap at the hyphen as "api-" / "guide/SKILL.md", which makes them a little harder to compare with option 4 `.claude/skills/api-guide.md` (pages/mobile-jp-24.png, pages/mobile-jp-25.png). They are still readable. Possible fix: put the difference in plain text, for example 「ホームフォルダの `~/.claude/skills/` に置く」 and 「プロジェクトの `.claude/skills/<名前>/SKILL.md` に置いてコミットする」, or use a shorter skill name.

section practice title: at 390 px 「演習：自分の手順をスキルに / し、調べものを任せる」 breaks between 「に」 and 「し」 (pages/mobile-jp-18.png). A shorter title such as 「演習：手順をスキルにし、調べものを任せる」 or 「演習：スキル作りと調べものの依頼」 would break more cleanly.

s2-skill: at 390 px source line 12 soft-wraps so that only 「で、」 sits on the continuation row (pages/mobile-jp-06.png). It is still readable; moving 「で、」 to line 13 in the source would avoid the orphan.

s4-check (q6) option 1: on desktop the last character 「た」 sits alone on the second line (pages/desktop-jp-12.png). Shortening it slightly (e.g. 「決まったテストのコマンドではなく、別のコマンドをClaudeが今日も使った」 to 「…今日も実行」 or similar) would avoid the orphan.
